title: From Macron's original promise to the unraveling of an ideal
subhead: 'The Macron Years' (1/3). After ten years in power, Macron's movement, which emerged as an attractive mirage amid the barren political landscape of 2017, has turned into a fiasco. subhead: Excessive heat, water shortages, rising sea levels: A place's habitability depends first and foremost on physical thresholds. But it also depends on the relationship between a space and the people who live there, which plays a key role in how people adapt to climate change.

title: How Jordan Bardella's political youth was shaped by antisemitic ideology
subhead: Accused of writing antisemitic messages when he was a young activist, an allegation he denies, the president of the Rassemblement National came of age politically in a milieu strongly influenced by Alain Soral. An antisemitic polemicist who briefly belonged to the party, Soral remained a popular figure on the French far right throughout the 2010s and, for some, an ideological compass.

title: France faces historic purchasing power crisis: Since 2024, families have lost €1,200/year on average
subhead: Real wages have been falling since 2019 – a rare phenomenon – but, for a long time, social transfers and income from assets made up for it. In 2025 and 2026, that is no longer the case. As a result, average purchasing power fell over two consecutive years, something that only happened twice since 1960.
